description: Generate QR codes for URLs, WiFi, contacts and text. Paid API key adds saved codes + analytics.
name: io.theqrcode/qr-code-generator

headers.description: Optional. Bearer <api key>. Without it the session is anonymous and exposes only generate_qr_code (url, wifi, contact, text; 100 req/hr per IP). A Developer ($19/mo) or Pro ($29/mo) key saves codes to the account and enables the email QR type, at 2,000 MCP requests/hr on Developer or 500/hr on Pro. list_qr_codes and get_analytics require a Developer key.
headers.name: Authorization

title: TheQRCode.io
